diagram_math_checks.objects: [M] denotes a graded-simple left A-module modulo even isomorphism; [N] denotes a simple left A^0-module modulo A^0-isomorphism.
diagram_math_checks.maps: Right arrow [M] -> [M^0]; left arrow [N] -> [A tensor_{A^0} N].
diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition supplier defines grading, graded simplicity and even isomorphism. Step 3.2 identifies graded submodules with A^0-submodules and step 4.1 proves induction is graded-simple for simple N. Even isomorphisms restrict and A^0-isomorphisms induce even isomorphisms, as explicitly established in step 4.1; hence both arrows are well defined on their displayed classes.
diagram_math_checks.relations: The left-then-right composite returns [(A tensor N)^0]=[N] using a0 tensor n -> a0 n, inverse n -> 1 tensor n (step 4.1). The right-then-left composite returns [A tensor M^0]=[M] using mu (step 3.1). No ordinary simplicity of the whole underlying ungraded A-module is asserted.

diagram_math_checks.objects: Upper left A^0 tensor_{A^0} M^0, upper right A tensor_{A^0} M^0, lower left M^0, lower right M; all are viewed as left A^0-modules.
diagram_math_checks.maps: Horizontal maps include the degree-zero direct summands (step 4.1). Left vertical mu_0(a0 tensor m)=a0 m; right vertical mu(a tensor m)=a m, restricted to A^0-module structures.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Balancing (ab) tensor m = a tensor (bm), b in A^0, makes both maps well defined by supplier universal property and step 3.1. Associativity gives A^0-linearity. The left vertical inverse is m -> 1 tensor m. For the right vertical, step 1.1 gives A^1=u A^0 and odd u^{-1}; step 2.1 gives the bijection m -> u m from M^0 to M^1. Under A^1 tensor M^0 congruent M^0, via u tensor m, the odd part of mu is exactly that bijection. Thus mu is an even graded A-isomorphism and in particular an A^0-isomorphism.
diagram_math_checks.relations: Both downward-right and right-down routes send a0 tensor m to a0 m in M. Elementary tensors generate the upper-left module, so the square commutes on every element. The inclusions need only be A^0-linear and are expressly not claimed A-linear.
